---
title: Revalidating
---

Revalidation updates cached data after it changes.

- In a Server Action where the user must see their own change right away, call `updateTag(tag)`. The tagged entry expires immediately and the next read waits for fresh data (read-your-writes).
- Elsewhere (Route Handlers, webhooks), call `revalidateTag(tag, 'max')`. The tagged entry is marked stale and served while fresh data loads in the background (stale-while-revalidate).

See `03-api-reference/04-functions/updateTag.md` and `revalidateTag.md`.
